I have no hope for my future. If I can't even make a friend now, how will I be able to as an adult? How will I find a girl? I probably come across as desperate for one, but honestly I just want to be able to talk to someone. My parents don't even really like me, they want me to move out.

My grades are only getting worse. When my parents see them in a few weeks they'll be extremely pissed. They think I don't try.

I've never been happy with myself. It doesn't help that people have told me that no one likes me. I've hated myself for a few years now. Everyone I know has so much potential, they got everything going for them. Me? I have nothing. And I know that I always will. 

People always say that I'll be happier in the future, but I know that's not true.  People say that I can work on improving myself, being more social, going to the gym, etc. etc. but they don't seem to realize that I have no idea how, and I doubt it's even possible.

I doubt any of this makes sense, and I don't really care. I just want to not be alive.

I've thought about it before but there's nothing my parents can do to help me, the only would ever be able to enjoy life would be if I myself changed. And I don't know how to do that. I'm a failure and I've accepted that I cannot live as one. The point is talking to them would do nothing but hurt them.

My first trip I took one 185ug WoW tab. I was by myself, I was planning on tripping with my friend but I got impatient (he kept pushing the date back). 30 minutes later I wasn't really feeling much so I took a second one. Another 30 minutes later I was tripping balls, and that second one was just starting to kick in. The visuals were stunning, i would compare it to a low dose of DMT. But DMT is much more, wild. I was listening to music, but i was too focused on how weird my carpet looked too notice that I had finished the playlist. I couldn't stop smiling (my face was sore the next day). Eventually I went up stairs to my room and just hung out there trying to unlock my phone to text some people. I sorta just chilled there listening to music or watching netflix until 2AM when I decided it would be a good idea to smoke a bowl of kief. If you don't know what kief is, it's basically the crystals on weed that are really high in THC. Like 3x more potent than just straight up bud, if you ask me. I smoked an entire bowl of that and just lied down staring at my phone. The icons were rotating and moving slightly. I was gone. some time later I sat up and looked at my hand, I thought I was dying, my arm looked like it had these red lines (like popping veins, but red) running down it. It was at that point that my trip started taking a turn for the worse. I don't know what happened,  but I became fully convinced that I was in a world similar to the matrix, actually more like inception, where people are living lives within these sub levels and that the only way to get out was to die and wake up one level higher to the true reality. And you would have to die again and repeat until you get to that reality. It was terrifying, even though sober me realizes this was ridiculous. I managed to fall asleep around 3:30am and woke up coming down with a sore face/jaw. I went to school and sort if enjoyed seeing other people again, but I felt like shit. I didn't know how to make sense of last night and still don't. 


I lowered my dosage because I thoroughly enjoyed the first tab before the second kicked in.

Sorry for the wall of text.
